claim.claim-text: 2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the apparatus is a handheld water gun.
3. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the chamber is octagonal, circular, square, or rectangular in cross-section.

4. The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a slider (112a) adapted to slide from a location that is proximal to the liquid dispensing outlet to a location that is distal from the liquid dispensing outlet.
5. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the tooth is connected to a lever (122), wherein the lever is constructed of a flexible material.
6. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the chamber extends longitudinally from the first end region to the second end region.
7. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the chamber extends at least 50% of a total length of the chamber housing.
8. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the liquid dispensing outlet is located in the chamber housing.
9. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the opening is fully concealed by the lid in the closed position and the opening is fully revealed by the lid in the open position.

10. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the lid comprises a locking mechanism that locks the lid to the chamber housing in the open position and unlocks the lid from the chamber housing in the closed position.

11. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the handle portion comprises a gripping portion (116) extending downward from the handle portion, the gripping portion adapted to facilitate gripping by a user's hand, wherein the gripping portion is angled with respect to the chamber housing.

12. The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising: an actuator (112) that injects air pressure inside the chamber to pump the liquid from the chamber through the liquid dispensing outlet during use, wherein the actuator causes the apparatus to exert air pressure on any liquid stored inside the chamber greater than ambient air so that the liquid is dispensed under pressure through the dispensing outlet during use.
13. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the body includes a pistol grip (116) near a back of the body.
14. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the opening (103) is between 3 square centimeters and 80 square centimeters in area.
15. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein a volume of the chamber is between 500 milliliters and 1 liter.
